-export function build(g) {}
+// Part "porches and facade ornament": porches, decks, pedimented and gabled entries, arcades, parapets and the
+// porch-side ornament of all eight plots (plan.md FACADES, ROOFS for the porch roofs, SITE for the ramps).
+// Everything here is built into air only; the shell, roofs and walks are earlier parts and stay locked.
+import {
+  portico, balcony, shapedParapet, arcadeBay, taperedPier, rafterTails, pedimentPorch, squarePorch,
+  doorHood, gablePorch,
+} from "../vocab.mjs";
+export function build(g) {
+  // ---- plot 0 Magnolia: full-height portico (4 quartz columns, pediment) and the balcony over the door ----
+  portico(g, { x0: 4, x1: 11, z0: 9, z1: 12, deck: "smooth_quartz", column: "quartz_pillar", trim: "smooth_quartz", rake: "quartz" });
+  balcony(g, { x0: 6, x1: 9, z0: 10, z1: 12, y: 5, floor: "smooth_quartz", rail: "iron_bars" });
+  // ---- plot 1 Alhambra: shaped parapet on the front wall, arcaded porch with a flat deck and red-tile pent ----
+  shapedParapet(g, {
+    piers: 10, vent: { x0: 23, x1: 24, y: 11 }, body: "white_terracotta", coping: "brick",
+  g.fill([19, 1, 9], [28, 1, 12], "mud_bricks");            // porch deck (the piers stand on it)
+  g.fill([19, 5, 9], [28, 5, 12], "mud_bricks");            // flat deck over the arcade
+  for (const x of [19, 28]) {                                 // side walls with an arch each, z10..11
+    g.fill([x, 2, 10], [x, 4, 12], "white_terracotta");
+  for (let x = 19; x <= 28; x++) g.set(x, 5, 8, ...brickStairs("south"));  // the pent, rising to the house
+  // ---- plot 2 Vallonia: tapered piers, beam, porch ceiling, deck, rafter tails over the front eave ----
+  for (const x of [35, 38, 42, 45]) taperedPier(g, { x, z: 9, stone: "cobblestone", post: "spruce", beam: "stripped_spruce" });
+  g.fill([35, 5, 9], [45, 5, 9], "stripped_spruce_log", { axis: "x" });
+  g.fill([35, 1, 9], [45, 1, 12], "spruce_planks");          // deck (the piers stand on it)
+  g.fill([35, 4, 10], [45, 4, 12], "spruce_slab", { type: "top" });   // porch ceiling, clear of the posts
+  rafterTails(g, { x0: 35, x1: 45, z: 8, y: 5, into: "south", wood: "spruce" });
+  // ---- plot 3 Puritan: pedimented entry porch, two quartz columns ----
+  pedimentPorch(g, { x0: 55, x1: 57, z0: 10, z1: 12, y: 1, facing: "north", trim: "quartz" });
+  // ---- plot 4 Cornell: full-width square-columned porch ----
+  squarePorch(g, { x0: 67, x1: 77, z0: 9, z1: 12, column: "smooth_quartz", pier: "bricks", frieze: "smooth_quartz", deck: "oak_planks" });
+  // ---- plot 5 Stanford: door hood over the centred door, landing before it ----
+  doorHood(g, { x0: 87, x1: 89, z: 13, y: 5, trim: "smooth_quartz" });
+  g.fill([87, 1, 12], [89, 1, 13], "smooth_stone");          // landing (the ramp runs z10..11 into it)
+  // ---- plot 6 Winona: small gabled porch on birch posts ----
+  gablePorch(g, { x0: 102, x1: 106, z0: 10, z1: 12, deck: "oak_planks", column: "stripped_birch", roof: "spruce", verge: "birch", infill: "smooth_sandstone" });
+  // ---- plot 7 Craftsman: broad porch on stone piers, beam, deck ----
+  for (const x of [114, 117, 122, 125]) taperedPier(g, { x, z: 9, stone: "cobblestone", post: "spruce", beam: "stripped_dark_oak" });
+  g.fill([114, 5, 9], [125, 5, 9], "stripped_dark_oak_log", { axis: "x" });
+// the pent's stairs: brick, bottom half, back to the given side (the way the pent rises)

+  return ["brick_stairs", { facing, half: "bottom", shape: "straight" }];

input.summary:
parts/porches.mjs builds the porch and facade ornament for all eight plots: Magnolia portico and balcony, Alhambra parapet, arcades, side arches, pent and deck, Vallonia tapered piers, beam, deck, ceiling and rafter tails, Puritan pedimented porch, Cornell square porch, Stanford door hood and landing, Winona gabled porch, Craftsman piers, beam and deck.
./make.sh finishes with a whole build.nbt; the porches line reports 631 placed with no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE writes. Zoomed renders of Alhambra and Magnolia read correctly.
Plan checklist item 4 is ticked, the matching elements.md items are ticked, and a Notes line lists what is not built.
left: Vallonia knee braces under the verges and eave (kneeBrace) not built.
Craftsman knee brackets under the rakes and eaves at y8 not built.
Alhambra pent down both sides not built (front only).
Craftsman mossy_cobblestone mix on the piers (1 in 4) not done.
Stanford door hood (x87..89 z13 y5..6) floats in this copy because shell-east is a stub and has no z14 wall at y5..6; re-check once shell-east lands.
Porch roofs (Vallonia sweep, Craftsman shed, Cornell hip, Winona gable) belong to the roofs part; porch ceilings built only for Vallonia (spruce slab at y4).

waste.what: Porch ceiling on Vallonia: skipped the post cells at y4 by hand, splitting the spruce_slab fill into segments around each post.
waste.cost: about 4 fill calls and one retry to get the post columns right
waste.tool: A porch-ceiling helper in vocab (porchCeiling(g, {x0,x1,z0,z1,y,skip:[[x,z],...]})) that fills the slab layer around posts.

waste.what: Side arches on Alhambra (x19 and x28 walls, z10..11): written as three fills per side by hand.
waste.cost: 6 fill calls worked out cell by cell
waste.tool: An arch helper for a side opening (arch(g, {axis, at, span, y}) producing wall, opening and lintel) in vocab.

waste.what: Checking the build: mcd check and fit print the whole row, so the porch lines had to be grepped out by hand; the front elevation at row scale is too small to read a porch.
waste.cost: 3 full-output reads and 2 zoom renders to inspect two plots
waste.tool: mcd zoom with a plot-range option (for example --plot 1) or a per-part filter in mcd check and mcd fit output.

waste.what: Changing the plan checklist and elements.md: the checklist line was edited by a sibling part at the same moment, so my first replace missed and I had to re-read the line before ticking.
waste.tool: A script that ticks a part's checklist entry by part number (tick-plan --part 4) and the elements items it built, so parallel workers do not race on the same line.

companions.task: The knee braces under the Vallonia verges and eave, the Craftsman bracket row under the rakes and eaves at y8, and the Alhambra pent down both sides, which sit where roof and porch meet.
The mossy_cobblestone mix on the Craftsman stone piers and checking the cobblestone piers on Vallonia and Craftsman against the plinth courses.
The Vallonia porch ceiling and rafter tails along the eave, so the wood trim lines up with the roof sweep.
The Stanford door hood and its landing, so its stairs sit on the z14 wall once shell-east builds it.
